meta.rule: Visual references are morphology inputs only; tokens, component specs, and product IA remain authoritative.
denied: palette composition or derived secondary palettes

meta.trigger: Implementation uses --ds-* tokens but recombines visual-reference-like dark rails, teal/blue secondaries, or status/tint roles into a new palette.
meta.rule: Token binding is necessary but not sufficient; color role composition must still follow the ontology palette roles.
meta.prevention: Derived colors may alias a semantic token or mix one semantic role with a neutral surface/transparent value. Do not mix multiple chromatic roles to create a local palette.

meta.rule: When implementation review identifies a repeatable design-system failure, promote it into governance, generated artifacts, and lint checks before treating the current screen as complete.

meta.selection_rule: Use when Codex exposes image-generation tooling or a model selector.

meta.usage: Optional Codex imagery when a screen needs professional raster substance.
meta.activation: only when the implementation surface would benefit from generated imagery

meta.activation: hero, landing, product, or editorial first screen

meta.usage: Content image for product, venue, object, media, or feature cards.
meta.activation: card grids or repeated content surfaces need real visual content

meta.usage: Cover image for articles, case studies, press stories, or narrative modules.
